tools.name: vector.info
tools.description: Inspect a vector document in your workspace (an SVG, a .vectorcraft file or another format the engine opens): artboards, the layer tree to `depth` levels (default 2, at most 8; every cut level reports its child count), object count, colour mode, units and import warnings. Reads only. `path` is relative to your workspace, the folder your own file tools (list_dir, read_file) see; files outside it cannot be named. A document that links a file outside your workspace is refused.

tools.name: vector.convert
tools.description: Convert a vector document in your workspace and write it there in the format `format` or else the extension of `out` picks: SVG/SVGZ, PDF, EPS, DXF, EMF/WMF, PNG/JPG/WebP/GIF/TIFF/BMP/TGA/PSD, or native .vectorcraft; `scale` (0.01 to 16) sizes raster output. A multi-artboard SVG export also writes numbered siblings, listed in `files`. Both paths are relative to your workspace (see vector.info); nothing is written outside it, and no existing file is ever replaced (a sibling's name included): choose a new name for `out`.

tools.name: vector.render
tools.description: Render one artboard (0-based `artboard`, default 0) of a vector document in your workspace to a PNG at `out`, its longest edge `max_side` pixels (default 1024). Both paths are relative to your workspace (see vector.info); nothing is written outside it, and a file already at `out` is never replaced: choose a new name.

tools.name: vector.run
tools.description: Run up to 64 commands from the vector engine's drawing and editing catalog, in order, on the document at `path` in your workspace or on a new default document, and export it to `out` when given (as vector.convert, never over an existing file). Each command is {id, params}. The engine's file and plug-in commands and path-like parameters are refused; file access stays inside your workspace. A generic engine command door: not granted to the system agent until it is reviewed separately.
